description:
Every project has its own conventions, scripts, and code style. In episode 8 of our beginner series, discover how to teach the GitHub Copilot app your specific project standards. Learn how to set up custom instructions in your .github folder, create repeatable skills for testing, assign custom agents, and connect MCP servers like Playwright for browser testing. Download the app today: https://github.com/features/ai/github-app?utm_source=youtube-copilot-app-ep8-description&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=copilot-app-for-beginners-series

#GitHubCopilot #CopilotApp #GitHub
